data.name: Esmaeel
data.long_meaning: Esmaeel is the name of the patriarch Ibrahim's (Abraham) son. According to Islamic tradition, Allah (God) gave Ibrahim this name because Allah heard Ibrahim's call to abandon his idols and follow the One God. In the Quran, Ibrahim is described as a prophet, an immigrant, and a man of deep faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes submission to the will of Allah.
